work.actor.title: Actor
work.handOver.title: go on with another agent
work.handOver.idle: It goes on in a new conversation with the agent you choose, in the same folder. Daoris hands that agent what it kept of this one: your request, its plan, its last words and what is uncommitted. The agent’s own context does not carry over.
work.handOver.working: Its turn is stopped, then it goes on in a new conversation with the agent you choose, in the same folder. Daoris hands that agent what it kept of this one: your request, its plan, its last words and what is uncommitted. The agent’s own context does not carry over.
work.handOver.nobody: No other agent is set up on this machine to hand it over to.
work.handOver.kept: It goes on with {{agent}} when its turn ends, in a conversation of its own.
work.handOver.keptQuest: It is stopped at the driver’s next look, then goes on in the same tree with {{agent}}.
work.handOver.unbriefed: The new conversation opened, but what Daoris kept of this one did not reach its agent: tell it where you were.
work.handOver.refused.notConversation: This is a quest’s session, which is handed over from a terminal for now: daoris-driver sessions hand-over.
work.handOver.refused.questClosed: Its quest is not open or taken any more, so there is no work left to hand over.
work.handOver.refused.questElsewhere: Its quest is not taken by this machine, so its work is not this machine’s to hand over.
work.handOver.refused.questReopened: Its quest lost its take because you reopened the work its step grew from, so its work is not this machine’s to hand over.
work.handOver.refused.notLastRun: A later session here carries this quest: hand that one over.
work.handOver.refused.parked: It is waiting on you: answer it instead.
work.handOver.refused.noDoor: That agent cannot drive this repository until it has adopted Daoris: choose another agent, or adopt the repository.
work.handOver.refused.unknownAgent: No agent on this machine is called that: choose one from the list.
work.handOver.refused.notItsAccount: That account does not belong to this agent: choose another.
work.handOver.refused.sameAgent: It already runs on that agent and account: choose another agent.
work.handOver.refused.running: It runs in another Daoris process on this machine: hand it over there, or stop it first.
work.handOver.refused.waiting: It is already waiting to be handed over.
work.handOver.refused.treeGone: The folder it worked in is gone, so there is nothing to go on in.
work.handOver.offer.label: hand-over offer
work.handOver.offer.near: This conversation’s account is near its limit.
work.handOver.offer.limit: This conversation’s account is cut until {{time}}.
work.delete.title: delete this session
work.delete.means: Deletes this conversation’s record and what this machine kept of it: its words, its transcript and its files. Nothing brings it back.
work.delete.done: Deleted {{id}}: its record, and its words, transcript and files on this machine, are gone.
work.delete.stayed: Deleted {{id}}: its record went, but the disk would not let go of {{what}}, now left over on this machine.
work.delete.kept.choice: its choice of a new session
work.delete.kept.hand-over: its ask to go on with another agent
work.delete.kept.help: its name and pin in Ask Daoris’s history
work.stop.title: stop this session
work.stop.drivenHeld: Stops the session now. Its quest stays taken here, its tree keeps what it wrote, and the driver will not carry it on until you choose Try again.
work.stop.drivenOpen: Stops the session now. The driver will not start #{{quest}} again on this machine until you choose Try again; another machine may still take it.
work.stop.parked: Stops it unanswered. Its quest stays taken here until you choose Try again.
work.stop.chat: Ends this conversation; it takes no more messages. Finish lets its agent wind up instead.
work.archive.none: Nothing that ended is left to archive.
work.archive.keptYou: Kept in the list: {{count}} waiting on you.
work.archive.keptReview: Kept in the list: {{count}} to review.
work.archive.keptBoth: Kept in the list: {{you}} waiting on you, {{review}} to review.
work.archive.done: Archived. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings it back.
work.archive.ended: Archived {{count}} session that ended. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings it back.
work.archive.ended_other: Archived {{count}} sessions that ended. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings them back.
work.archive.endedKept: Archived {{archived}} of {{count}}; the rest changed since the list. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings them back.
work.archive.back: Unarchived. It is back in the list.
work.archive.wasNot: It was not archived, so nothing changed.
work.notStarted.here: Not started: {{agent}} did not offer {{model}} on {{account}}.
work.notStarted.mirror: Not started: the agent did not offer the model.
work.limit.label: Waiting for a limit
work.limit.waits: Waiting for a limit to reset: it resumes by itself at {{time}}, on {{account}}.
work.limit.noReset: No reset was said: it tries again at {{time}}.
work.limit.own: It goes on in its own conversation.
work.limit.briefed: It goes on as a new part of its session, handed Daoris's brief.
work.limit.notLifted: Its last reset did not lift the limit: {{hit}}.
work.timeline.title: Timeline
work.timeline.hint: what was observed — process lifetime, the quest's transitions, and what landed in git. Never a reading of the stream.
work.attended.none.headline: Nothing attended
work.attended.none.body: Choose a session in the session list and it opens here — its record, what was observed, and its console while it runs.
work.context.label: context
work.context.measured: Context: {{used}} of {{size}} tokens ({{percent}}), as the agent last reported it. The most this session has held is {{most}}.
work.context.pending: Not measured yet: this agent has not reported its context. It does as a turn runs or when one ends, and a stopped turn may report none.
work.context.text: Not measured: this agent’s door carries only text, so it reports no context.
work.context.unknown: Not measured: nothing has reported this session’s context.
work.meter.tookFirst: Took {{took}} by this machine’s clock; the first answer came after {{first}}.
work.meter.tokens: As the agent reported it: {{input}} tokens in ({{fresh}} new, {{written}} written to its cache), {{read}} read from its cache, and {{output}} out.
work.find.label: Find in this session
work.intake.title: Intake for ask #{{ask}}
work.intake.hint: The declarations did not settle whose this is, so the intake asked rather than guess. The answer is on the ask: publish it to a repository, or close it, and this session ends at the driver's next look.
work.intake.stopMeans: Stopping ends the intake without answering: the ask stays a proposal for you to publish or close.
work.intakeRunning.title: This intake is reading ask #{{ask}}
work.intakeRunning.hint: It takes no messages: an intake is one turn. If the declarations do not settle whose this is, it asks you by parking, and the answer is on the ask.
work.frame.none: No session is attended. Choose one in Sessions, and its timeline and its review follow it here.
work.frame.ended: The session attended in Sessions has ended, so nothing follows it here. A session's timeline and its review follow it here while it runs or waits on you.
work.monitor.title: Monitor window
work.monitor.subtitle: Everything running, live. Read-only — the moves stay in the main window.
work.monitor.elsewhere: Runs on {{origin}}. Its console stays on that machine; what travelled here is the record.
work.monitor.empty.headline: Nothing is running
work.monitor.empty.body: This window fills as the driver takes quests and as you open conversations in the main window.
work.monitor.driverStopped: The driver on this machine is not running, so nothing will start here.
work.detached.gone.headline: No record of that session
work.detached.gone.body: It is not in this workspace's ledger — it may have been in another workspace, or this window outlived it.
work.options.group: this conversation's model and effort, as its agent offers them
work.options.label: this conversation's {{name}}
work.steer.placeholder: tell it something while it works — the conversation shows when it reads it. Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a newline.
work.steer.nowTip: send this now, in the turn it is on. The session keeps going, and keeps what it has done.
work.steer.stopKeeping: Stop its turn so this goes next…
work.steer.stopKeepingAsk: This stops the step it is on and its turn. What it has done stays, and what waits goes next.
work.steer.notNow: It could not take these now, so they are held as queued words are.
work.steer.notNowNextStep: Its agent cannot be steered mid-turn, so these go at its next step.
work.steer.notNowBehind: Other words are already on their way to it, so these wait behind them.
work.steer.notNowOpening: It is still opening, so these go as soon as it has opened.
work.steer.notNowTurnEnd: Its door cannot take words in a running turn, so these are held for its turn to end.
work.say.placeholder: write to it — the same session goes on with your words
work.say.heldEnding: held until this run ends — then the same session goes on with them
work.say.waiting: waiting for the same session to go on with them
work.say.tooLong: This agent's door takes at most {{count}} characters at once; shorten it, or send it in parts.
work.say.cannot: It cannot go on in this session, because {{why}}.
work.say.startChat: Start a conversation with these words
work.say.goOnBriefRefused.agentGone: The agent it ran on is no longer on this machine: hand it over to another agent to go on with these words.
work.say.goOnNew: Go on in a new session
work.say.newSession.loses: A new session can take your words now, without this conversation's context.
work.say.newSession.sent: A new session takes your words at the driver's next look, without this conversation's context.
work.say.newSession.running: It is still running, so your words reach it there; it needs no new session.
work.say.newSession.noWords: No words of yours wait on it to go on with.
work.say.newSession.conversation: A conversation does not go on in a new session by itself; start a conversation with these words instead.
work.say.newSession.closed: #{{quest}} has closed, so nothing carries its words on by itself; start a conversation with them instead.
work.say.newSession.notCooling: Its account is not cooling any more, so the same session goes on with your words at the driver's next look.
work.say.teammate: This session ran on another machine, where its conversation is.
work.say.stoodDown: It stood down: #{{quest}} is someone else's, so it has nothing to go on with.
work.say.intake: An intake takes no words: it is answered through its ask.
work.say.opinion: A second opinion's reviewer takes no words: it reads the work once and says its opinion, which goes to the session whose work it read, and to you.
work.say.help: Ask Daoris's conversations take words in its own panel, which starts a new one.
work.say.superseded: #{{quest}} went on in a later session here, so write to that one.
work.say.continued: It went on in conversation {{to}}; say it to that one.
work.say.notFound: Daoris no longer has this session's record, so nothing can take words for it.
work.say.notTaken: Nothing took these words just now, so they are back in the box.
work.say.why.account: its conversation stays with the account it ran on, and this start runs on another
work.say.why.adapter: it ran on {{from}}, and starts here now run on {{to}}
work.say.why.unkept: Daoris kept no id for its conversation
work.say.why.offered: the agent offers no way to continue a conversation
work.say.why.gone: the agent no longer has its conversation
work.say.why.refused: its conversation could not be continued
work.say.why.elsewhere: its conversation is open in another client of {{agent}}
work.say.why.teammate: it ran on another machine, where its conversation is
work.say.why.intake: an intake is answered through its ask
work.say.why.stoodDown: it stood down, so it has nothing to go on with
work.say.why.started: you started a conversation with them
work.say.why.exited: its agent ended before it reopened its conversation
work.say.why.resumed: its quest resumed in a new session once the question it waited on was answered
work.say.startFrom.running: It still runs, so your words reach it there; it needs no new conversation.
work.say.startFrom.noWords: No words wait on this session now, so there is nothing to start a conversation with.
work.say.startFrom.carried: Its quest is still open, so the driver carries these words on with it by itself.
work.dock.label: right side bar
work.dock.cramped: This side bar is too narrow to sit beside the session — close it, or widen the window.
work.views.right: views in the right side bar
work.views.toRight: Move {{view}} to the right side bar
work.views.empty: Nothing is here now. Move a view here from its tab's menu, or reset the view locations.
work.sitting.CannotShow_unnamed: This set-up step shows its work in `{{environment}}`, and no review rule here names `{{environment}}`, so it cannot start.
work.sitting.CannotShow_noAddress: This set-up step shows its work in `{{environment}}`, a local environment that declares no address, so it cannot start.
work.sitting.CannotShow_noWindow: This set-up step shows its work in `{{environment}}`, a local environment at {{address}}, and there is no window here to show it in, so it cannot start.
work.sitting.AtCapacity_cap: The concurrency cap ({{cap}}) is spent — it frees as sessions finish.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_opening: `#{{quest}}` is starting on this machine already: its session opens once its tree and account are ready.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_tree: Session `{{session}}` is active in the tree `#{{quest}}` goes back into — one session per tree.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_treeOpening: Queued behind quest `#{{other}}`, which is starting in the tree `#{{quest}}` goes back into — one session per tree.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_treeThisLook: Queued behind quest `#{{other}}`, which goes into the tree `#{{quest}}` goes back into at this look — one session per tree.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_repository: Session `{{session}}` is active in the receiver's repository — one session per repository, whose root is its one tree. Sessions there run side by side once they open trees of their own.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_queued: Queued behind quest `#{{other}}` in the receiver's repository — oldest first, one at a time.
work.sitting.RepositoryBusy_repositoryOp: Queued behind quest `#{{other}}`, which is starting in the receiver's repository — one session per repository, whose root is its one tree.
work.sitting.Waiting_asked: Waits on `#{{other}}`, asked of `{{to}}` — it goes on, in the same tree, once that is answered.
work.sitting.Waiting_unreadRunning: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done: its evidence is read when session `{{session}}` ends — it goes on, in the same tree, once that evidence is found.
work.sitting.Waiting_unread: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done, and its evidence is not read yet — it goes on, in the same tree, once the evidence is found, `daoris-driver quest check {{other}}`, or once you accept the done as it stands, your yes: `daoris-driver quest accept {{other}}`.
work.sitting.Waiting_unreadAtCommit: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done, and its evidence is not read yet — it goes on, in the same tree, once the evidence is found, `daoris-driver quest check {{other}} --commit <sha>`, or once you accept the done as it stands, your yes: `daoris-driver quest accept {{other}}`.
work.sitting.Waiting_missing: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done without the evidence it names — it goes on, in the same tree, once a later commit holds it, `daoris-driver quest check {{other}} --commit <sha>`, or once you accept the done as it stands, your yes: `daoris-driver quest accept {{other}}`.
work.sitting.Waiting_unreviewed: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done: it waits for your review — it goes on, in the same tree, once you say it is reviewed, `daoris-driver quest review {{other}} reviewed`, or skip the review, `daoris-driver quest review {{other}} skip`.
work.sitting.Waiting_unreviewedIn: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done: it waits for your review in `{{environment}}` — it goes on, in the same tree, once you say it is reviewed, `daoris-driver quest review {{other}} reviewed`, or skip the review, `daoris-driver quest review {{other}} skip`.
work.sitting.Waiting_departed: Waits on `#{{other}}`, which `{{to}}` closed done departing from what you required — it goes on, in the same tree, once you accept that, your yes: `daoris-driver quest accept {{other}}`.
work.sitting.NotAdopted_unregistered: The receiver is not registered on this machine, so there is nowhere to start it.
work.sitting.NotAdopted_noRoot: The receiver has not adopted Daoris and no root is known for it on this machine, so there is nothing to start and nothing there to see the quest.
work.sitting.NotAdopted_noConnector: The receiver has not adopted Daoris, so a session there would have no connector to take the quest with — only the protocol door hands it one. Drive with an ACP agent, or adopt it.
work.sitting.WaitsForOpinion_landing: Set-up step `#{{quest}}` waits for a second opinion on the work it shows, so you look once at work that already answered another agent. The opinion: {{state}}.
work.sitting.WaitsForOpinion_landingUnju: Set-up step `#{{quest}}` waits for a second opinion on the work it shows, which is not judged yet.
work.sitting.WaitsForOpinion_steps: Waits for a second opinion on the step before it, `#{{other}}`, before it starts. The opinion: {{state}}.
work.sitting.WaitsForOpinion_stepsUnjudg: Waits for a second opinion on the step before it, `#{{other}}`, before it starts: it is not judged yet.
work.sitting.SourceReopened_withdrawn: Quest `#{{quest}}` grew from the work of `#{{other}}`, which you reopened: it is withdrawn, and nothing starts it until you go on with it on the new work or abandon it.
work.sitting.SourceReopened_held: Quest `#{{quest}}` grew from the work of `#{{other}}`, which you reopened: it is set aside, and nothing carries it on until you go on with it on the new work or abandon it.
work.sitting.TransientHeld_transient: Its last session's provider kept failing: it waits for your words or Try again.
work.sitting.Stopped_steward: The steward stopped session `{{session}}`; Try again, by the steward or the owner, carries it on.
work.sitting.Blocked_checkout: Its earlier work is in your checkout, so carrying it on is yours.
work.facts.callWaits: waiting for your answer to {{title}} for {{elapsed}}
work.facts.callWaitsUnnamed: waiting for your answer to a tool call for {{elapsed}}
work.facts.attempt: attempt {{attempt}}: the one before it failed
work.heavy.label: Heavy gates
work.heavy.waiting: waiting for the heavy run · behind {{session}} · {{time}}
work.heavy.waitingTip: This repository's heavy gates run one run at a time: this session waits its turn behind another run, not on you.
